M25-0068-F02 — Division-path and orthomorphism guarantees allow unavailable identity colour — Counterevidence: Multiplication case differs; actual sequenceability applications remove identity.
M25-0068-F03 — Lemma 3.9 permits deterministic leftovers too large for the random reservoir — Counterevidence: Actual main application has q <= reservoir density /100.

M25-0068-F04 — Lemma 3.4 lacks a density bound — Counterevidence: An arbitrary density-dependent size threshold for fixed positive delta avoids this family but supplies no uniform polynomial-density bound; actual use has polynomially growing degree.

proposition.claim:
Recorded check: For every rank r>=3, H=<12>xC2^(r-1) in S3xC2^(r-1), b=(123), A=H-{e,a}, B=Ab. Quotient-symbol sum precludes a transversal; difference subgroups H and b^-1Hb are distinct, ruling out both printed exceptions.

Recorded check: All odd N>=5: G=Z_N, x=0,y=-1,V=G-{0,-1},C=G-{1}. Every stated division hypothesis holds; zero is in C but on no edge, so N-1 rainbow edges cannot use only N-2 available colours. Separate asymptotic construction meets the random perturbation and sum hypotheses in 4.9.

Recorded check: C2^m with index-two cosets H,J; p=.1,q=.45; X=(H\R_A,H\R_B,J\R_C). Every edge uses R, leaving at least (.75+o(1))n vertices, larger than n^.9999 asymptotically.

Recorded check: r disjoint C2 multiplication blocks are linear, degree 2, with n=2r vertices per part and delta=2/n; at most r matching edges leave 3n/2 vertices.

Recorded check: p=1/4, sufficiently large n, S=U={v}, v nonidentity, satisfies all hypotheses but cannot be covered in H_G[Q]\U. Also S outside Q with U empty. Main use includes target vertices outside R superset Q.
